title: 43-acre Virginia farm behind an inclusive riding programme for people with disabilities listed for $8.4 million
summary_full: Wheatland Equestrian's historic Virginia property is being sold for approximately $8.4 million.  This sale will support the Faith and Family Foundation's long-term mission.  The organization began in 1999, offering inclusive equestrian opportunities for all riders.  It gained national recognition as a USEF Para-Dressage Center of Excellence.  The proceeds will ensure continued services for children and adults with disabilities.
